description: Use this when a Phorme coach (or their agent) asks where their AI coach's training stands. It returns the stage (study, first or rate), the one next step to take, and counts of passages, corrections, principles and rating rounds with the last score. Always read next from here; never assume the stage. It reads only. It needs a connected Phorme account that owns the brain.

brain_id.description: The brain id of the coach's own build, for example "cameron".
